# awscc_glue_connection (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Glue::Connection



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `catalog_id` (String) The ID of the data catalog to create the catalog object in. Currently, this should be the AWS account ID.
- `connection_input` (Attributes) The connection properties used for this connection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_input))
- `name` (String) The name of the connection.
- `tags` (String) The collection of tags. Each tag element is associated with a given resource.

<a id="nestedatt--connection_input"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connection_input`

Read-Only:

- `athena_properties` (String) Connection properties specific to the Athena compute environment.
- `authentication_configuration` (Attributes) The authentication configuration used to connect to the connection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_input--authentication_configuration))
- `connection_properties` (String) A map of key-value pairs used as parameters for this connection.
- `connection_type` (String) The type of the connection that needs to be created.
- `description` (String) A description of the connection.
- `match_criteria` (List of String) A list of criteria that can be used in selecting this connection.
- `name` (String) The name of the connection.
- `physical_connection_requirements` (Attributes) The physical connection requirements. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_input--physical_connection_requirements))
- `python_properties` (String) Connection properties specific to the Python compute environment.
- `spark_properties` (String) Connection properties specific to the Spark compute environment.
- `validate_credentials` (Boolean) A flag to validate the credentials during create connection. Default is true.
- `validate_for_compute_environments` (List of String)

<a id="nestedatt--connection_input--authentication_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connection_input.authentication_configuration`

Read-Only:

- `authentication_type` (String) A structure containing the authentication configuration in the CreateConnection request.
- `basic_authentication_credentials` (Attributes) For supplying basic auth credentials when not providing a SecretArn value (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_input--authentication_configuration--basic_authentication_credentials))
- `custom_authentication_credentials` (String) A structure containing the authentication credentials in the CreateConnection request.
- `kms_key_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the KMS key used in the authentication configuration.
- `o_auth_2_properties` (Attributes) A structure containing properties for OAuth2 in the CreateConnection request. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_input--authentication_configuration--o_auth_2_properties))
- `secret_arn` (String) The secret manager ARN to store credentials in the CreateConnection request.

<a id="nestedatt--connection_input--authentication_configuration--basic_authentication_credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connection_input.authentication_configuration.basic_authentication_credentials`

Read-Only:

- `password` (String) The password used in the authentication configuration.
- `username` (String) The username used in the authentication configuration.


<a id="nestedatt--connection_input--authentication_configuration--o_auth_2_properties"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connection_input.authentication_configuration.o_auth_2_properties`

Read-Only:

- `authorization_code_properties` (Attributes) The set of properties required for the the OAuth2 AUTHORIZATION_CODE grant type workflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_input--authentication_configuration--o_auth_2_properties--authorization_code_properties))
- `o_auth_2_client_application` (Attributes) The OAuth2 client app used for the connection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_input--authentication_configuration--o_auth_2_properties--o_auth_2_client_application))
- `o_auth_2_credentials` (Attributes) A structure containing the OAuth2 credentials used in the authentication configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_input--authentication_configuration--o_auth_2_properties--o_auth_2_credentials))
- `o_auth_2_grant_type` (String) The grant type used in the authentication configuration.
- `token_url` (String) The URL used in the authentication configuration.
- `token_url_parameters_map` (String) A map of key-value pairs used in the authentication configuration.

<a id="nestedatt--connection_input--authentication_configuration--o_auth_2_properties--authorization_code_properties"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connection_input.authentication_configuration.o_auth_2_properties.authorization_code_properties`

Read-Only:

- `authorization_code` (String) The authorization code used in the authentication configuration.
- `redirect_uri` (String) The redirect URI where the user gets redirected to by authorization server when issuing an authorization code.


<a id="nestedatt--connection_input--authentication_configuration--o_auth_2_properties--o_auth_2_client_application"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connection_input.authentication_configuration.o_auth_2_properties.o_auth_2_client_application`

Read-Only:

- `aws_managed_client_application_reference` (String) The reference to the SaaS-side client app that is AWS managed.
- `user_managed_client_application_client_id` (String) The client application clientID if the ClientAppType is USER_MANAGED.


<a id="nestedatt--connection_input--authentication_configuration--o_auth_2_properties--o_auth_2_credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connection_input.authentication_configuration.o_auth_2_properties.o_auth_2_credentials`

Read-Only:

- `access_token` (String) The access token used in the authentication configuration.
- `jwt_token` (String) The JSON Web Token (JWT) used when the authentication type is OAuth2.
- `refresh_token` (String) The refresh token used when the authentication type is OAuth2.
- `user_managed_client_application_client_secret` (String) The client application client secret if the client application is user managed.




<a id="nestedatt--connection_input--physical_connection_requirements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connection_input.physical_connection_requirements`

Read-Only:

- `availability_zone` (String) The availability zone where the connection is located.
- `security_group_id_list` (List of String) The security group ID list used by the connection.
- `subnet_id` (String) The subnet ID used by the connection.
